html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · November 28, 2022

On Nov 28, 2022, pharmacy-retail management SaaS Hualing Tech (华瓴科技) closed a multi-hundred-million RMB Series A led by Shenzhen Capital Group (深创投) with Hongtu Bailey and Xiongdi Lian participating. Use: digital platform R&D, market expansion, innovation businesses. First public financing since Jun 2021 founding.

HQ Suzhou; product/R&D centers in Changsha, Chengdu, Nanjing. Core team 20y+ industry ops; 10,000+ pharmacy ERP/digital upgrades. Brand “Yaode (药德)” SaaS delivers iterative ops management for drug retail — cost efficiency plus desirable/accessible/economical support. Chair Wu Xinghua holds 33.8%; three natural persons + institutional shareholders. Shenzhen VC Hongtu Healthcare GP Zhou Yi: digitalization is pharmacy retail’s path to efficiency; Hualing’s decades of depth can enable multi-party win.

— END —
